release_notes:
v2.0.5838 – Web Tracker Mode & Sync Fixes

🔹 Permanently Open Tracker (NEW):
- The embedded Sandtime.io dashboard is now always visible on the left side.
- No more clicking to open it — it loads automatically on startup.
- Sidebar button changed from 'Open Tracker' to 'Reload Tracker' (refreshes the embedded page).
- The ✖ close button has been removed since the panel is permanent.

🔹 Timer Drift Fix (CRITICAL):
- The tool's live timer now starts at 00:00:00 when you click 'Stop tracking' on the dashboard.
- Previously it was reading the Goals/daily-total timer and jumping to values like 04:21.
- JS selector now skips the Goals/activities section and picks the timer nearest the Stop button.
- The tool now trusts its OWN clock after detecting the running state — no more re-seeding drift.

🔹 Greyed-Out Start/Stop Button:
- The tool's Start/Stop button is now a passive status indicator (greyed & disabled).
- All timer control flows through the embedded Sandtime.io dashboard.
- Hover the button to see a tooltip explaining where to control the timer.

🔹 Activity Rename on Folder Switch:
- When you switch folders mid-session, the tool attempts to rename the running
  activity on Sandtime.io via API (PATCH /activities/{id}).
- If the server rejects the rename, no harm — the timer keeps running unaffected.
- Check 🔍 View Logs to see DESC_UPDATE entries.

🔹 All previous fixes remain:
- Correct user_id matching by name (from 2.0.5837)
- Stop verification against the server
- Timer stays running if stop fails (both sides stay in sync)

🔹 Everything else unchanged from 2.0.5837.
